# Screenshot Planning — Dead Code & Drift Radar

## Screenshots

### 1. Gutter Icons in Editor
- **Title:** "See Code Health at a Glance"
- **What to capture:** An open source file with green, yellow, and red gutter icons next to different code sections. Show a mix of active and drifting code.

### 2. Hover Tooltip Detail
- **Title:** "Rich Drift Information on Hover"
- **What to capture:** Mouse hovering over a gutter icon, showing the tooltip with last author, last change date, reference count, and drift score breakdown.

### 3. Project View with Badges
- **Title:** "Spot Drifting Files Instantly"
- **What to capture:** The project explorer tree with drift badges on files showing different status levels (active, drifting, abandoned).

### 4. Drift Radar Dashboard
- **Title:** "Full Project Drift Overview"
- **What to capture:** The Drift Radar tool window showing a sortable table of all files with their drift scores, last modified dates, and status indicators.

### 5. Project Heatmap (Pro)
- **Title:** "Visualize Drift Hotspots"
- **What to capture:** The heatmap visualization showing the entire project structure with color-coded areas indicating code health.

### 6. Scan Results Summary
- **Title:** "Actionable Scan Results"
- **What to capture:** The scan completion notification and the results panel showing the number of files in each drift category.

### 7. Settings Panel
- **Title:** "Configurable Thresholds"
- **What to capture:** The plugin settings page showing threshold configuration sliders and scoring weight options.

### 8. CI Integration Output
- **Title:** "CI/CD Pipeline Integration"
- **What to capture:** Terminal showing the Gradle task output with drift scores and threshold enforcement.

## Video Demo Outline (50 seconds)

| Time | Scene | Description |
|------|-------|-------------|
| 0-5s | Intro | Show plugin name and tagline over a code editor |
| 5-15s | Scan project | Run "Scan Project for Drift" from Tools menu, show progress |
| 15-25s | Gutter icons | Navigate through files showing green/yellow/red icons |
| 25-35s | Hover details | Hover over icons to show tooltips with drift information |
| 35-45s | Dashboard | Open the Drift Radar tool window, sort by score, highlight worst files |
| 45-50s | CTA | Show "Install from JetBrains Marketplace" with plugin URL |
